# gl_test case 8 (blend) on the NanoPC-T6 under the board's Mesa 25.0.7, for
# the frame builder's blend-shader proof (src/mali/frame_blend_tests.rs):
# frame 5 (glBlendColor(0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0), CONSTANT_COLOR /
# ONE_MINUS_CONSTANT_COLOR, drawn with a blend shader) and frame 1 (SRC_ALPHA /
# ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA, fixed function): each blended draw's command-stream
# words up to its RUN_IDVS, the descriptor buffer its d50 names, and frame
# 5's blend-shader buffer. Cut by hand-picked line ranges (the blended draw
# is a frame's second, which tools/mali/board_dump_cut.py does not take).
#   mesa-blend.pandecode sha256 b07b92c8bcd2280ef10f5d56a6642ff1dbf7a96742adecb44b0d7d6aa5b3a344
#   (0dce654a8:tools/mali/board-ref/2026-10-20-mesa-refs/mesa/, gl_test cases.c mode blend)
